items.subject: Existing complete FY2019/20 SOFI or October 22, 2020 Board attachment 4.2.1
items.body:
Please provide an existing complete final Statement of Financial Information for the year ended March 31, 2020, or a complete copy of the October 22, 2020 Board of Governors agenda attachment 4.2.1. Please include the as-disclosed Board/employee remuneration and expense schedules, definitions, controls and approval pages. An existing native electronic schedule would also be suitable if already held.

The current public file https://www.nic.bc.ca/_resources/pdf/statement-of-financial-information-2019-20.pdf has nine physical pages. It contains employee printed pages 2 of 5 and 4 of 5, while printed pages 1, 3 and 5 are absent. Please identify the requested record by its internal year ended March 31, 2020; the current reporting index also links its 2020/21 label to this same file.

The former full agenda URL is https://www.nic.bc.ca/pdf/bog/agenda/2020-2021/20201022_BOG_agenda.pdf. Its preserved archive contains all five salary pages, but the archive expressly truncates the package to 1,048,576 bytes versus a reported original length of 3,739,511 bytes. The October 22, 2020 minutes, page 4 item 4.2.1, record approval of the year ended March 31, 2020 Financial Information Act information.

The complete visible salary scopes have already been recovered: 136 employee and 15 Board observations. This request is for an existing complete preservable original, including its surrounding records, rather than additional personal information or inferred salary rows.

Please use the ordinary no-fee existing-copy route. An existing PDF or working public link is sufficient; no new analysis or new record is requested. No statutory application, paid search or fee is authorized. If a charge or formal application would be required, please reply before taking that step.

Thank you.

items.subject: Existing corrected council schedule or period record for the 2025 SOFI
items.body:
Please provide any existing corrected council remuneration and expenses schedule for the year ended December 31, 2025, or an existing written record identifying the reporting period of the five council rows in the posted 2025 SOFI.

The five council rows on physical page 42 of the published SOFI (https://mcbride.civicweb.net/document/45990) explicitly carry a 2024 heading and total $42,578.05 expenses. The same rows and 2024 heading appear on physical page 44 of the adopted presentation (document 45891) and page 9 of the final annual report (document 45695). The separately published 2024 council expenses total $60,151.87. We are preserving these literal observations and are not assuming which period or total should be changed.

The signed June 30, 2026 minutes (document 46177), motion 090630.26, establish package adoption. The remaining request concerns the council table's period, including any existing corrected 2025 schedule or issuer record that explains that heading.

Please use the ordinary no-fee existing-copy route. An existing PDF or working public link is sufficient; no new analysis or new record is requested. No statutory application, paid search or fee is authorized. If a charge or formal application would be required, please reply before taking that step.

items.subject: Existing corrected FY2024/25 SOFI declaration/management page and SOFI approval record
items.body:
Please provide any existing corrected declaration or management report, existing published explanation of their printed years, and any existing Board minutes or resolution explicitly approving the Statement of Financial Information for the year ended June 30, 2025.

The posted complete SOFI is https://sd10.bc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/SD10-2024-2025-SOFI-sv-1.pdf. Its remuneration schedules on physical pages 47–48 explicitly state the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025. On physical page 3, the declaration certifies the year ended June 30, 2024 despite a 2024–2025 year field and signatures dated December 18, 2025. On physical page 5, the management report prints December 18, 2024 beneath a June 30, 2025 header.

An abridged current copy, SD10-2024-2025-SOFI-sv.pdf, repeats the same declaration and management pages. We are retaining the printed years and are not inferring a typo or approval date. items.subject: Existing corrected FY2025/26 SOFI heading, aggregate explanation and adoption record
items.body:
Please provide any existing corrected employee salary page 52, existing written explanation of the aggregate differences below, and any existing minutes or resolution explicitly adopting the FY2025/26 Statement of Financial Information.

The posted final redacted SOFI is https://sd8.bc.ca/sites/default/files/documents/2026-09/2025-2026%20SOFI%20Report_Final_Redacted_0.pdf. Its physical page 52 prints June 30, 2025, while the other employee schedule pages print June 30, 2026. All 340 employee monetary rows agree with the separately dated September 8, 2026 Board agenda's complete remuneration schedule on physical pages 185–193, which consistently prints June 30, 2026. We are preserving the conflicting posted heading without assuming a cause.

On physical page 64, the posted reconciliation prints $56,431,182 remuneration and $594,827 expenses. Schedule page 59 prints $56,431,196 remuneration and $594,437 expenses. Reconciliation minus schedule is therefore −$14 remuneration and +$390 expenses. The named employee controls reconcile; this request concerns an existing correction or explanation of those two aggregate sets.

The September 8 minutes record SOFI presentation, rather than an explicit adoption motion; the October 13 agenda repeats those minutes. Please provide an existing SOFI-specific approval record if held. No new reconciliation analysis or newly prepared record is requested.

Please use the ordinary no-fee existing-copy route. An existing PDF or working public link is sufficient; no new analysis or new record is requested. No statutory application, paid search or fee is authorized. If a charge or formal application would be required, please reply before taking that step.

Thank you.
